scanner: Wave 5 Subagent W5-18 Security Audit Suite

cuda_amp_violations.details: Zero deprecated torch.cuda.amp usages. All trainer and utility code migrated to torch.amp per Rule 2.1; legacy shim annotated with # allowed.

weights_only_violations.details: Zero unannotated weights_only=False deserialization calls. Remediated neuralops/surgery/model_surgery.py to strictly enforce weights_only=True.

secret_leaks.details: Zero exposed HuggingFace tokens, OpenAI keys, GitHub tokens, or cloud credentials across neuralops/, tests/, and docs/.

silent_swallow_violations.details: Zero naked silent exception swallows (except: pass or except Exception: pass without # allowed-swallow:).

hardcoded_device_violations.details: 25 occurrences of cuda:0 detected, primarily in CLI documentation, arg defaults, and standalone evaluation scripts in neuralops/evaluation/standalone/. Remediated neuralops/validation/gates/empirical/vram.py; logged remaining standalone scripts to issues/wave6_hotfix_backlog.md.

unsafe_deserialization.details: All 13 torch.load call sites verified. Every active checkpoint loader (surgical_io.py, lora.py, teacher_cache.py, etc.) strictly enforces weights_only=True.

dynamic_execution_ast.details: AST walk across 1822 Python files verified zero built-in eval() or exec() invocations in library source code.

dependency_vulnerabilities.details: pip-audit not installed in local Python environment. Local packages pinned; CI security workflow recommended.
